sample: The handles close around your Machete — REDACTED. For two rounds it is just a shape in your hands. (Strikes are unarmed.)
The bar thins, flickers — nothing left loud enough to redact. It is STARVING. (Its attacks weaken; starve it one more turn and it flees.)
While you were gone — 3 things you missed:
While you were gone — one thing you missed:

🔥 The fire settles. Daniyar has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Tick — I put it down today." "It waits. The questing legs wave — the tell." "Adjacent = attached. No dodge. It's ON you." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Marta mutters "We've been walking past those." Carl breathes "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
While you were gone — one thing you missed:
📺 You take 26 damage.
While you were gone — one thing you missed:

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
